name: World's Crossing Academy
source:
Set in a world where fantasy races exist, but in separate dimensions. Through the development of Goblin technology, these dimensions were able to be bridged, and the World's Crossing Academies were created.

We've all dreamed of living on another world at some point. In this world, it is possible. Those who are interested in living amongst another species can go through schooling at the World's Crossing Academy to learn that culture. Schooling begins at the Academy branch on your homeworld. Then you'll move to the Nexus Academy between worlds. Finally, you'll attend finishing school on the world you chose. Sounds pretty epic, right?
translation:
故事发生在一个存在奇幻种族的世界，但存在于不同的维度。通过哥布林技术的发展，这些维度得以弥合，并创建了跨越世界的学院。

我们都梦想在某个时刻生活在另一个世界。在这个世界上，这是可能的。那些有兴趣与其他物种生活在一起的人可以在穿越世界学院接受教育，以了解这种文化。学校教育从你家乡的学院分校开始。然后你将移动到世界之间的Nexus学院。最后，你将在你选择的世界上完成学业。听起来很史诗，对吧？
